free_tier.stated: Large storage servers with NVMe cached HDDs in RAID6. Our budget storage starts at just $2.5 per TB of HDD storage and our Hybrid Storage Servers with NVMe boot drive starts at just $3.75 per TB of storage!

per_object_cap.notes: Each Premium StorageBrr tier lists configurable HDD block storage with 500 GB included; the page states no per-object cap and no step size for the configuration.

retention.notes: No retention period is stated. The terms page states unpaid services are terminated three days past the due date and active data and backups are destroyed.

egress.terms: Metered: 3,000 GB on the 1 GB plan, 5,000 GB on the 2 GB, 10,000 GB on the 4 GB, 15,000 GB on the 6 GB, 20,000 GB on the 8 GB. @ 1 Gbps. No published overage rate.

chaining: Hosted in Falkenstein, Germany. NVMe cached HDD block storage is configurable on each tier. The page does not state root-level access to the block.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: none. Block storage is 'NVMe cached HDD .. RAID6'. Not for latency-sensitive work. The provider says so explicitly.
